scientific_integrity: Exact finite-alphabet proof with a determinant-two parity map; computational tests are corroborative and are not evidence for every parameter. No independent priority determination or mathematical audit.
scientific_limitations: The formulas assume exactly two adjacent cyclic translations and the subgroup of even modulations in dimension 2p.
Window entries have equal magnitudes and phases among all qth roots of unity.
The probability law assumes independent uniform phases; nonuniform distributions are not covered.
No independent mathematical audit or publication-priority verification has been performed.
title: Quantized-phase cyclic Gabor bases: an exact parity-code spectral law
